name: Idle Tree Keeper
detailed_description:
Idle Tree Keeper is a cozy idle/incremental game where you play as a small Kodama, gathering magical seeds to reforest a once-thriving forest.

As you progress, you automate your tasks and unlock whimsical upgrades like an arcane watering can, the favor of the Pachamama, or a squirrel accountant who helps reduce forest taxes.

The game features a soft, charming aesthetic, with resets allowing you to purchase furniture for your woodland home, each piece offering passive bonuses and further upgrades.

It's a peaceful blend of nature, magic, and idle strategy.

Core features (in development):

  • Collect seeds to buy upgrades that will help you get more seeds!

  • Enjoy the company of your little kodama friend y make sure it has a cozy home!

  • Stay alert! A flower might appear to double your production, or even a unicorn that triples it! 

  • Incremental system with cool items.

  • Pretty animations.

  • Original and beautiful ambience music and sound effects.

  • Prestige system to reset progress and gain permanent bonuses.

  • Peaceful and colorful visual style.

This game is in active development. We plan to add seasonal events, customizable visual content, and more in future updates. Community feedback will play an important role in shaping the game.

Idle Tree Keeper will be free to play with optional in-game purchases. There will be no paywalls, and all key progression systems will be accessible through regular gameplay.

Add it to your wishlist to stay updated and follow our development journey.

short_description: Idle Tree Keeper is a relaxing idle/incremental game where you care for a mystical tree. Generate resources, unlock upgrades, evolve, and progress even while offline. Free to play with optional in-game purchases.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3100 or AMD FX-4300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU (Intel HD 4000 or equivalent)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (NVIDIA GTX 960 or AMD Radeon R7 370)
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.11 El Capitan or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (dual-core) or Apple Silicon (via Rosetta 2)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU with Metal support (e.g., Intel HD 4000 or Apple M1)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard or integrated
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (quad-core) or Apple Silicon (M1 or newer)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with Metal support (e.g., AMD Radeon Pro) or Apple M1/M2 GPU
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard or integrated
